title: Cloudy Survival
description: Survival upgraded but better for high end gaming pcs
body:
# ☁️ Cloudy Survival

**Cloudy Survival** is a survival-focused Minecraft modpack currently in **Beta**, designed for players with **higher-end PCs**. The pack includes a large collection of mods and is intended to provide an enhanced survival experience, but it may require more powerful hardware for smooth performance.

The modpack is still under active development, so you may encounter bugs, missing features, balance issues, or other unexpected behavior. Some mods or mechanics may not work as intended yet.

If you find any issues, your feedback is appreciated and helps improve future updates.

### Beta Notice

* ⚠️ This modpack is still in beta.
* 💻 Designed for higher-end PCs.
* 🐞 Bugs and crashes may occur.
* 🔄 Features and the mod list may change between updates.

Thanks for trying **Cloudy Survival**, and enjoy your adventure!
